subject: Will Factor Rotation critera works in mixedmirt()?

messages.author: 6a75f6f91a59c568
messages.subject: Will Factor Rotation critera works in mixedmirt()?
parts:
Dear Phil,

Will Factor rotation criteria work in mixedmirt()?

Like this;
testMLIRT_MODEL <- mixedmirt(data = fulldata[1:9], model = 2, itemtype = 'gpcm', covdata = persondat, lr.fixed = ~1+age+Role, lr.random = ~1+teamyear|teamid)
coef(testMLIRT_MODEL, rotate = 'geominQ')

I want to see rotated(?) item parameters 'a' in the exploratory setting. Cheers.

Seongho

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Will Factor Rotation critera works in mixedmirt()?
parts:
Strange, I thought mixedmirt complained if a model was exploratory. In the passed this wasn't allowed for the reason that exploratory IRT models shouldn't be included with explanatory factors (they lose a lot of meaning). I'll patch this to throw the error again.

Phil
